hops.rationale: The subquery asks for AMZN's FY2023 (filed 2024) cloud infrastructure operating costs and cloud business competition. The cost side is well supported. Passage 000064 says AWS operating income rose on higher sales, partly offset by spending on technology infrastructure driven by AWS growth, and gives Technology and infrastructure expense of $85,622M vs $73,213M. Passage 000151 gives the AWS segment net sales ($90,757M) and operating expenses ($66,126M vs $57,255M, with operating income of $24,631M). Passage 000067 and 000097 define infrastructure costs (servers, networking equipment, data center depreciation, rent, utilities supporting AWS). Competition is absent from every passage. The AWS segment description only says it sells compute, storage, database and other services to start-ups, enterprises, government and academic customers. No passage names competitors, market position, pricing pressure or competitive dynamics, so that element is missing and caps the score at 3.
